title: Template Definition Schema
description: Schema for validating Claude Code template file metadata (.claude/templates/**/*.md). Templates use {{PLACEHOLDER}} syntax for variable substitution.

name.description: Template name matching the filename (without .md extension)

description.description: What this template produces and when to use it

category.description: Template category for organization and discovery

name.description: Placeholder token as it appears in the template (e.g., AGENT_NAME)

description.description: What value should be substituted here

required.description: Whether this placeholder must be substituted before use

placeholders.description: List of {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens in this template

output_type.description: What artifact type this template produces (e.g., 'agent.md', 'spawn-prompt', 'report.md')

consumer.description: Which agent, skill, or workflow uses this template
